target: US company-operated fuel margin before electronic payment fees, not broader US road fuel margin or after-fee target
geography: Audit available current official footprint and archived releases. Block historical reweighting unless dated target-matched company-operated regional exposure is supported; do not use mixed dealer/affiliate counts or backfill current weights
challenger: Keep existing own-basis fiscal market-model prediction, add half the mean of last4 available reported fiscal YoY margin changes as recent-level seasonal anchor offset
history: Same archived full training history as comparator, same market features and equal-third provisional region weights; no shorter-history confounding introduced
publication: For each target only outcomes strictly published before target fiscal end and with end earlier than target start; change pairs both published. Require4 supported fiscal YoY changes; exclude target actual
baselines: Prior-year-only; recent-level seasonal without market correction. No new fitted coefficient or lag search
acquisitions: Preserve release acquisition/divestiture passages and whether named transactions appear in current or prior-year release; retrospective documentary flags only, no cents correction, no outcome-based exclusion
evaluation: All42 archived out-of-fold targets and modern start>=2021 separately; original >=5c errors descriptive only; report ordinary-quarter cost, RMSE and large-error frequency
promotion: Existing frozen gate, no automatic promotion or post-result parameter tuning
